decisions.statement: Every name akasha keeps is named here and nowhere else.
The folder git does not track is named here once.
A name akasha keeps sits directly under that folder.
That folder is answered both under a root and on its own.
A store is a name akasha keeps that holds a tree.
A hold a landing takes is a name akasha keeps that is no store.
A path akasha kept before and keeps no longer is named here as well.
That path is read against the folder git does not track.
A path named there is a sweep's whole reach.
A path goes from there once every checkout has been swept of that path.
A path under a store is named by the owner of that path.
A store is answered under a root.
A guard settles a store against a root.
A refusal names a store as text.
Where a store sits is an answer.
Whether anything is there is asked of the disk by the caller.
The files a store has are not said here.
A name git keeps for itself is no store.

definition: every name akasha keeps under the folder git does not track
